clips.title: The story
paras: Along Webwinder Path, secluded Boulderslide Ravine cuts through the central peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains. The ravine has seen little of the fighting between Horde and Alliance. Its rocky slopes lead toward Boulderslide Cavern, while wild mountain beasts still roam there.

Boulderslide Ravine lies off Webwinder Path in the Stonetalon heights. Loggers, night elves, and the Horde battle over timber and sacred glades elsewhere in the region, but military forces rarely disturb this narrow pass. Mountain rams and crag beasts such as Cliff Stormers roam its ledges and sheer stone walls. Prospectors watch the slopes, where rich mineral veins often surface along the way toward the deeper cavern network.

Across from Boulderslide Cavern's entrance, a small cave overlooks the ravine. Rough torches light its weathered supply barrels and primitive tribal paintings. The crude designs resemble ancient tauren art, suggesting native tribes once traveled through these crags or found temporary shelter here, long before modern conflict reached the mountains.
